name: abap2ui5-test
description: Test abap2UI5 apps in ABAP - a headless frontend simulator that speaks the abap2UI5 request/response protocol without a browser.

scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.auto_downport: (abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc || true) && npm run syfixes && npm run strip_trailing_ws && abaplint .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
